commons_proposal.limits: Dry staples alone are not a meal for someone without safe water, fuel or cooking space. Large stockpiles that expire or are inaccessible can reduce resilience.
commons_proposal.name: A protected food floor within a controlled commons
commons_proposal.status: Proposal, not stocked or authorized for operation
commons_proposal.success_measure: Defined essential meals remain deliverable for the locally chosen interval without exhausting neighbors or depending on inaccessible space.
commons_proposal.who_can_act: A food bank, community organization, tenant association and controlled-space host acting with food-safety and accessibility partners

findings.claim: Feeding America's FY2025 report records 4.3 billion pounds rescued and 7.2 billion pounds sourced nationally. About 60% is an analyst calculation using rounded figures, not a universal food-bank ratio. Observation period July 1, 2024–June 30, 2025.

ACCFB's FY2025 audit identifies purchased food, donations, government food and food recovery as distinct channels. Its annual report describes wholesale-price access through Raley's and a five-food-bank purchasing partnership supported by a $2.5 million foundation grant. These are operating examples of procurement beyond rescued surplus; neither establishes current uncommitted reserve.

DOE identifies return-to-base delivery, refuse and bus duty cycles as practical electrification candidates. Range depends on load, terrain, weather and auxiliary power. Vehicle service support, chargers, electrical service and charging downtime must be included.

A 2018 DOE case study documents Meals on Wheels People in Portland using electric shore power for truck refrigeration while parked. This is established staged diesel-load reduction, not a new 2026 event or evidence that vehicle propulsion became electric.

USDA AMS describes competitive food purchasing from approved domestic vendors and coordinated demand planning for nutrition programs including TEFAP. Government food is not simply supermarket leftovers.

A broad production or logistics shock can reduce donated inflow while higher prices increase demand and weaken food-bank purchasing power. This is a conditional coupled exposure, not evidence of a current famine. An affordability shock can instead leave ample food in commerce, and some disruptions temporarily increase stranded surplus.
findings.confirm: Comparable inflow by source falls while demand, cost per nutritious meal and failed fulfillment rise; separate common shock from unrelated funding change.
findings.falsify: Stable or rising usable inflow and purchased fulfillment cover demand without drawing protected stocks or exhausting staff.

findings.claim: Food-waste prevention can be a healthy transition while shrinking rescue donations. The essential function to preserve is nutrition access, with stable procurement and income support replacing dependence on waste. More discarded food is not the desired reserve.

DOE describes converting a combustion vehicle by removing its engine and adding batteries, motors, high-voltage wiring and instrumentation; battery packaging, weight placement and chassis suitability need assessment. Replacement of the whole vehicle and repowering an existing chassis are separate options.

Diesel electrification migrates dependence from recurring delivered fuel toward electrical service, chargers, equipment support and battery supply. It can free fuel for harder-to-electrify tasks if the displaced fuel remains deliverable; eventual refinery contraction can offset that reserve. Neither free diesel nor independent electric operation is automatic.

No current ACCFB supply percentage, protected meal-days, contract rights, September physical inventory, or donor excess was established. No named East Bay electric fleet candidate has a verified route, purchase budget, energized depot or service commitment in this thread.

limitations: Eight admitted primary/operator sources; broad web search repeatedly returned irrelevant results, so official navigation/direct pages were used.
No current famine inferred. Historical 2018/2025 findings are late discoveries or design evidence, not new September 2026 events.
No universal national/local food-bank supply mix assumed. No monthly local delivery data or independently verified reserve inventory obtained.
Electric agriculture/construction feasibility is not established for particular equipment. No universal cost saving or depot construction timeline asserted.
No outreach, procurement, scheduling or resource commitments made. No independent review of this thread completed here.

reserve_framework.interpretation: Prefer reserves with different failure causes, and countercyclical funding or capacity that can expand when demand rises. Do not assert statistical negative correlation without data.
measure: Essential nutrition/meal requirement, with dietary needs and ready-to-eat options
Protected edible inventory after commitments and spoilage
Inflow by rescued, donated, government and purchased channels
Supplier origin, watershed, season, fuel, port, route and distributor overlap
Funding restrictions, cash availability and replenishment price
Cooking water/energy, refrigeration, staff and accessible distribution hours
Lead time and physical delivery probability under the scenario
Donor home floor and maximum safe outgoing commitment
reserve_framework.rule: Assess the reserve during the same event that makes it necessary, not only during ordinary operation. Different organization names are not independent supply routes.
workarounds: Protected rotating staples and ready-to-eat meal stock used in routine service and replenished before its minimum floor is breached
Stable pooled purchase budget and diversified supplier agreements alongside rescue
Paid or guaranteed farm procurement with fair producer terms; diversify geography as well as farm count
Preserve SNAP/CalFresh access or cash where shops are stocked; cash cannot replace missing physical food
Prearranged alternate delivery routes, warehouse space, refrigeration power and trained staff
Government and interregional supply coordination for broad physical shortfalls, protecting each donor community floor
